description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Verition is a multi-strategy, multi-manager hedge fund focused on global investment strategies. The Associate Platform Engineer will build, maintain, and support internal web applications, data workflows, and AI-assisted tooling while improving performance, testing, deployment, and operational support. The role also provides first-line assistance to internal users and helps mature engineering practices.
Platform engineer building internal web applications, data integrations, SQL tooling, and AI assistant support

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain features across a suite of internal web applications used across the business
• Deliver the steady stream of small, high-visibility requests: new fields, layout and usability improvements, filtering, export and upload handling
• Improve query and page performance on tools that are used daily
• Write and tune SQL to answer business questions and diagnose issues in operational and reference data
• Investigate and resolve data-quality problems — malformed values, mismatched identifiers, records failing validation
• Support the flows that move data between internal systems, and help build the derived or historical datasets that source systems do not retain themselves
• Contribute to the integration layer that connects internal systems to LLM-based tooling — building and testing tool interfaces, improving error handling, and extending logging and administration
• Support internal AI assistant features through functional testing, access-control testing, and triage of reported behavior
• Package and document tooling so non-technical colleagues can use it without hands-on help
• Act as first-line support for internal users — access requests, permissions, and environment or configuration problems
• Handle account and role provisioning and the associated directory group changes
• Own routine operational tasks: deployments, scheduled restarts, cache management, and monitoring of automated jobs
• Keep runbooks, release notes, and status updates current
• Help mature the codebase — source control conventions, branching, code review, and continuous integration
• Stand up development environments so changes can be tested properly before release
• Add automated testing, starting with the paths that break most often

Requirements:
• 1+ year of experience in a similar position
• Strong Python skills and comfortable working in a web application codebase (HTML/CSS/JavaScript)
• Strong proficiency in Python — joins, aggregation, window functions, reading an execution plan
• Ability to take a vague request to a working, deployed result without being managed through every step
• Ability to explain a technical constraint in plain language, and follow up without being chased
• Experience with Docker, Linux, and cloud infrastructure
• Practical experience with LLM tooling — agent frameworks, tool-calling integrations, or building against an LLM API
• Familiarity with issue tracking and documentation tooling
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• High level of intellectual curiosity, strong work ethic, and keen attention to detail
• Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, fast-paced, and dynamic environment

Preferred:
• Exposure to financial services is preferred — trade lifecycle, securities reference data, or fund and portfolio structures
